job.title: Senior Project Manager - Operating Model implementation
job.description:
We're seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a high-profile investigation into future op model options for a nationally significant scheme.

Reporting to senior business owners, you'll drive an evidence-based investigation that builds on existing assurance and due diligence work already completed, to shape recommendations that make the scheme more efficient, effective and robust.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and coordinate an end-to-end investigation into future operating model options, following confirmation of scope, purpose and policy/funding parameters.
  • Assess the respective roles and responsibilities of the key parties and agencies involved in delivering the scheme.
  • Review existing technology systems and administrative arrangements supporting the scheme, and capture lessons learnt to date.
  • Evaluate governance, accountability, procurement and funding settings.
  • Undertake comparative analysis of operating models used in other jurisdictions.
  • Define success measures across customer experience, investment, and scheme integrity.
  • Develop requirements for an administration system to support future operational delivery, including input into an investment case / proof of concept.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, stakeholder engagement and reporting to ensure the project delivers agreed outcomes.
  • Work closely with senior business owners to keep the investigation aligned to agreed objectives.
About You
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder investigations or reviews, ideally within government or public sector environments.
  • Strong understanding of operating model design, governance frameworks, and procurement/funding arrangements.
  • Skilled at synthesising input from audits, due diligence reviews and technical assessments into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross-agency partners.
  • Strong analytical and report-writing skills, with experience developing business or investment cases.
  • Comfortable operating within a structured PMO environment, reporting into a programme management office.
  • Relevant project management qualification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) is an advantage.
What's on Offer
  • A high-impact, hourly rate project role shaping the future of a nationally significant scheme.
  • The opportunity to work alongside experienced senior leaders across strategic policy, operations, and programme delivery.
  • A defined, outcomes-focused engagement running October 2026 – February 2027.
How to Apply If you have the project leadership experience and public sector insight to drive this investigation forward, we'd love to hear from you. Click Apply Now to submit your CV, or contact the Momentum Consulting team for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Technical Marketing Automation Lead
job.description:

You’ll work closely with the CRM team to understand friction across existing customer journeys and help create a more connected approach across CRM, marketing automation, data and the wider MarTech ecosystem. The broader role is focused on building scalable, data-driven customer journeys and ensuring technology, data and automation work together effectively.

About the role You’ll help shape and execute the MarTech strategy, with a particular focus on how different platforms, data sources and customer touchpoints come together.

This will include:
  • Working directly with the CRM team to understand current pain points and orchestrate improved customer journeys.
  • Looking beyond individual MarTech channels and considering how the wider CRM and customer ecosystem works collectively.
  • Designing and optimising automated workflows across marketing, service, cross-sell and customer engagement.
  • Supporting integrations and data flows across platforms, including APIs and data ingestion.
  • Working with technologies and approaches such as data clean rooms and preference centres.
  • Using customer and performance data to continually improve journeys, automation and personalisation.
  • Working across marketing, data, analytics, technology and other teams to turn strategy into practical solutions.
The role will also have ownership across optimisation of the MarTech stack, integrations and continuous improvement of automation processes.

About you

We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and doing the work.

You’ll ideally bring:
  • Strong experience across MarTech, CRM and/or marketing automation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and optimising marketing automation platforms.
  • A good technical understanding of data flows, APIs, integrations and ingestion.
  • Experience designing and orchestrating customer journeys across multiple channels and touchpoints.
  • Exposure to clean rooms, preference centres and customer data environments.
  • The ability to move comfortably between high-level strategy, solution design and hands-on execution.
  • Strong stakeholder skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • A personable, collaborative approach and the confidence to influence how things are done.
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud experience would be advantageous,
This is a particularly interesting opportunity for someone who enjoys joining an environment where there is real scope to improve and mature the capability, rather than simply maintaining an established MarTech setup.

Based in Auckland with hybrid working available.
Applicants must have the right to work in New Zealand.

job.title: Data & AI Governance Lead
job.description:
As AI adoption accelerates across this business, someone needs to make sure it scales responsibly. This is a newly created leadership role at a well known New Zealand financial services organisation that has spent the last six months building out a genuinely capable AI function, and now needs an experienced governance lead to build the frameworks that let the business move fast without losing control. 

You will not be running the AI use cases yourself. You will be the person who makes sure they are governed properly, from data quality through to responsible AI oversight. 

The Role 
  • Develop and operationalise enterprise data and AI governance frameworks, policies, standards and controls 
  • Lead data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership and stewardship initiatives across business domains 
  • Govern AI and advanced analytics across the full lifecycle, including use case assessment, testing, human oversight, monitoring and incident management 
  • Partner closely with technical delivery teams, the AI function and enterprise Risk and Compliance 
  • Prepare governance reporting and evidence for senior forums, assurance providers, auditors or regulators 
  • Work closely alongside the AI Delivery Lead to keep data and AI initiatives aligned and well governed 
What You'll Bring 

Must haves: 
  • 7+ years' experience in data governance, information governance, AI governance, privacy, risk, compliance, data management or a related discipline 
  • Demonstrated experience developing and operationalising enterprise governance frameworks, policies, standards and controls 
  • Practical experience leading data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership, stewardship or data access initiatives 
  • Experience governing AI or advanced analytics across the lifecycle, including testing, human oversight, monitoring and incident management 
  • Experience partnering with technical delivery teams and Risk or Compliance functions 
  • Experience preparing governance reporting for senior forums, auditors or regulators 
Nice to haves: 
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated, operationally complex environment (strongly preferred) 
  • Data governance, privacy, risk, assurance or responsible AI certifications 
Why This Role 

This organisation is NZ owned, ambitious and moving quickly, with the governance in place to back it up. The AI team is genuinely well credentialed, with people drawn from Microsoft, the banks and Spark, and it is growing fast, which means this role has real influence over how that growth happens. You will get real investment in your own development too, including relevant certifications, Snowflake training and access to a dedicated leadership programme for people managing direct reports. Auckland based, with a hybrid working pattern. 

How to Apply 

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, apply now or reach out to leshagrey@momentum.co.nz for a confidential conversation. Please note you must be NZ Citizen or NZ Permanent Resident to apply.

job.title: Change Manager

  • Central North Island and surrounding regions
We’re looking for an experienced Change Manager to support a significant regional clinical systems consolidation programme across Central North Island and surrounding area. 

This is a complex change environment spanning multiple districts, clinical systems and stakeholder groups, so we’re looking for someone comfortable working through ambiguity and bringing structure to large-scale technology change.

You’ll lead change management activity across a programme focused on consolidating and improving clinical portal capability across the region.

Working closely with programme and delivery teams, clinical leaders, operational teams and technology stakeholders, you’ll help understand the current environment and prepare impacted teams for significant changes to systems, processes and ways of working.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Developing and delivering the change strategy and approach.
  • Undertaking change impact and readiness assessments across multiple districts.
  • Mapping stakeholder groups and building strong engagement with clinical and operational teams.
  • Supporting communications, engagement, training and adoption activity.
  • Identifying change risks, resistance and dependencies early.
  • Working closely with project, technical and clinical teams to support successful implementation.

About you
We’re looking for an experienced Change Manager who has delivered complex technology or digital transformation programmes within large organisations.

You’ll ideally bring:
  • Strong end-to-end organisational change management experience.
  • Experience working across complex, multi-site or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Confidence engaging with senior leaders, operational teams and frontline users.
  • Strong change impact, readiness, communications and adoption experience.
  • The ability to work effectively where scope, dependencies and solutions are still evolving.

This is a substantial programme with significant organisational complexity, making it well suited to a Change Manager who can quickly understand the landscape, build credibility and provide clear direction through change.

Applicants must have the right to work in New Zealand and be based in Waikato, Taranaki, Bay of Plenty, Lakes (Rotorua and Taupō) or Tairāwhiti (Gisborne).

job.title: Finance Business Partner
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Our client is one of New Zealand's largest fully integrated logistics providers, offering seamless global supply chain solutions; from international freight to warehousing and domestic delivery. With a team of over 450 people and an extensive footprint of 13 branches and 6 warehouses nationwide, they are recognised for their leading-edge technology and long-standing partnerships with multinational and local customers.

We are seeking an experienced Finance Business Partner to join their finance team, supporting the Transport business unit with high-quality financial insight and commercial guidance. 

Based in Auckland, this role is pivotal in providing meaningful, purposeful information to business managers on the performance of the Transport business units. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders including the CEO, CFO, GMs and the wider Finance team, to drive profitability and support sound decision-making across the business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Managing Transport business unit P&Ls to ensure targets are met
  • Consolidating, producing and distributing weekly P&Ls and monthly actual/budget/last-year variance reports and commentary
  • Analysing key financial and non-financial business drivers to add value across the Transport business
  • Partnering with business unit managers to develop strategies that maximise profit
  • Preparing budgets and updating budget data into the Finance Management System
  • Courier billing, revenue calculation and cost of sales coding
  • Preparing forecasts, customer sales reports and short-term incentive (STI) schedules
  • Contributing to the ongoing development of customer profitability reporting
  
What We're Looking For  
  • Post-graduate qualification in Business or Accounting, including CPA/CA
  • Experience within Transport and Logistics, 3PL, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, or a related industry is preferred but not essential
Skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Systems solutions and process improvement focus
  • Self-directed, with the ability to manage and mentor others
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills
  
Why Apply? This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established, technology-driven logistics business with a strong safety culture and a genuine focus on people, service and performance. You'll work alongside experienced GMs and senior finance leaders in a role with real influence over commercial outcomes.

job.title: Senior Project Managers - fixed term opportunities
job.description:

Working alongside a Programme Manager and multiple General and Team Managers, you'll coordinate activity across several interconnected workstreams — including contract changes, provider engagement and assessment, investment frameworks, and phased service recommissioning — while managing risks, dependencies and competing priorities across the programme.
Both roles are highly collaborative, with success driven by influence, facilitation and strong stakeholder relationships rather than formal authority.

  • Developing and maintaining integrated delivery plans across workstreams
  • Managing project scope, budget, schedule, risks and dependencies
  • Supporting contracting, procurement or commissioning activity where relevant
  • Coordinating change, communications and stakeholder engagement activities
  • Identifying risks and issues, ensuring timely escalation
  • Preparing reporting and governance information for senior leaders and steering groups
  • Coaching teams and stakeholders in effective project and programme management practices
  • Building and maintaining strong internal and external relationships
About You
  • Significant experience leading and delivering complex IT/technology or business change projects within a structured PM framework
  • Strong stakeholder management, consultation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to influence, negotiate and build consensus without direct authority
  • Sound judgement, with the ability to advise senior leaders and governance groups
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Resilience, adaptability and a pragmatic, outcomes-focused approach
  • Relevant tertiary qualification and/or PM certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile) desirable

If either of these opportunities sounds like your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now with your CV, or contact us for a confidential discussion about which role could be the right fit.

 This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone that enjoys building high-quality, intuitive applications.

Right to work
To be considered for this role, applicants must be a New Zealand citizen or permanent resident, or hold a valid New Zealand work visa that entitles them to work in this position, in accordance with New Zealand immigration requirements.
